findings.text: No test proves that a career page redirecting to another origin whose robots.txt is 'Disallow: /' makes the company skipped; the cross-origin branch (res.url vs targetUrl origin, second guard.isAllowed(res.url)) in FallbackEngine.extractJobs is never exercised by robotsGuard.test.js, and fallbackEngine.test.js/adapters.test.js were not changed.

findings.ac: AC3 User-agent: CleanTechHub group blocks enrichment
findings.text: enrichCrawler.test.js only uses 'User-agent: *' groups; no test with a 'User-agent: CleanTechHub / Disallow: /' group proves crawlCompanySite (userAgent 'CleanTechHub') returns null for it, as the AC explicitly requires.
robotsGuard.test.js has no timeout (AbortController 5 s) or rejected-fetch case; only 503 and endless-redirect cases are tested, although the test title claims 'network errors'.

findings.ac: Path/Stress: enrichment robots redirects capped at 5 via safeFetch(url,{maxRedirects:5})
findings.text: createRobotsGuard calls fetchImpl(url,{redirect:'manual',...}) without maxRedirects, and safeFetch ignores `redirect` and defaults maxRedirects to 3, so in enrichment a robots.txt with 4-5 redirects throws 'too many redirects' -> robots_unreachable, contradicting the 5-hop requirement; no test covers it.

findings.ac: Path enrichment: re-check final origin after safeFetch redirect
findings.text: crawlCompanySite diff adds no cross-origin redirect re-check of the final origin (fetchPage only adds hasTdmReservation); the Path requires re-checking when safeFetch followed a redirect to a different origin, and nothing tests it.
Tests cover longer Disallow beating shorter Allow (/careers/private vs /careers) and equal-length tie; no case where a longer Allow overrides a shorter Disallow.
No parseRobotsTxt/createRobotsGuard test with 'User-agent: CleanTechHub-JobIngestion / Disallow: /'; 'Disallow: /' is only tested under '*' in integration tests.
No test feeds an HTML body to parseRobotsTxt/createRobotsGuard to prove it is treated as an empty ruleset (allow).

findings.ac: AC2 two companies on one origin -> one robots fetch
findings.text: Caching is tested at guard level (one guard, three URLs) but not through runAtsIngestionBatch with two companies on one origin.
runAtsIngestionBatch test asserts skipped length and fakeClient.from not called but never asserts result.failures is empty.

AC names fallbackEngine.test.js and adapters.test.js, but integration tests were added to robotsGuard.test.js and those two files are unchanged, so the AC's verification command does not run the new coverage.
run-job-ingestion.js logs 'Compliance skip' lines and companiesSkipped, but no test covers this output or the DRY_RUN path.

findings.ac: Stress: enrichment robots fetch keeps safeFetch SSRF guard
findings.text: Code defaults fetchImpl to safeFetch, but no test asserts that robots.txt requests in crawlCompanySite go through safeFetch (the tests mock safeFetch and would not distinguish).
